transitionStructuredPlan.summary: Transitioning from Cashier to Registered Nurse (RN) in Ontario, Canada requires completing an approved nursing education pathway, meeting College of Nurses of Ontario (CNO) registration requirements, and passing the required registration exam. This regulated profession demands building core clinical skills such as clinical judgment, documentation, and patient care planning, alongside practical experience in clinical systems and medication safety. The path typically takes 12 to 48 months to become employable, with full qualification potentially taking up to 60 months. Entry-level RN wages range from CAD 27 to 41 per hour, increasing to CAD 44 to 54 per hour when fully qualified.
